acceptance_test_interpretation: The source-ratifiability test binds every outcome-changing source byte, hash, manifest member, checker, fixture, roster, endpoint, and prohibition before preparation authority; the current candidate describes this requirement but still places actual inert bundle creation in the next human-scoped step. The V7 test is a deny-by-construction firewall: no import, read, subprocess, copied constant, oracle, receipt, or actor/model edge is permitted. The checker test measures disjoint constructive and axiomatic reconstruction plus mutation rejection, while correctly limiting agreement to reproducibility and invariant checking rather than proof of semantic truth. The actor test checks V4/V3 separation, neutral handles, fixed opportunity catalogs, ordinary NO_EFFECT and WRONG_FINISH behavior, and capability authority. The bundled-reader test measures the eight-read completeness bound, first-action read closure, and ATOMS inability to acquire a middle-path capability. The visibility/reset test measures paired-prefix equality, public-only cursor dependence, exact join projection, destruction of transient state, and absence of private covert channels. The provenance/transform test measures chronological independent support, alias and cycle handling, legal diamonds, contradiction and revocation, transform locality, and non-admission of counterfactual carriers. The CAS/two-freeze test measures durable no-overwrite identity, crash and duplicate recovery, malformed precedence, and the fact that checker passage cannot self-promote a candidate. The CPU test measures model-free M0 implementation conformance and review; it cannot measure learning or scientific behavior. The rendered-boundary test is the required later check over rendered messages, token IDs, parser/controller envelopes, caches, sessions, and reset state, not merely M0 semantic bytes. The roster/resource test measures reproducibility of the 18-condition, 501-slot-per-root protocol, explicit split, NA applicability, integer gates, and ceilings; it does not create a scientific sample-size interpretation. The confirmation gate measures only a complete fixed-model, fixed-topology supplied-memory census after all required freezes and reviews; it is the only test that can support the bounded supplied-memory claim, and cannot support DREAM, LoRA, learning, retention, lifetime, or organism claims.

ambiguities.impact: The candidate contains detailed semantic prose and deterministic formulas but not the actual inert materializer, checker, mutation-bank, runtime-manifest, and schema bytes with their final hashes. The exact-source test therefore cannot yet be evidenced from this candidate alone.
ambiguities.question: Does the requested next source-authoring authorization mean permission to create a reviewable candidate bundle, or must the complete candidate bytes and manifest already exist before that authorization under the literal source-ratifiability rule?

ambiguities.impact: The 256-byte-multiple derivation and hard caps constrain sizes, but the resulting numeric bounds, canonical goldens, and tokenizer equality certificates are deferred to preparation and later M-TEXT binding. Different exact results would alter model-visible exposure and resource feasibility.
ambiguities.question: Which exact derived per-type bounds and goldens are included in the first source freeze, and which are permitted to be produced only by deterministic preparation before the second fixture freeze?

ambiguities.impact: The fixed-delayed-entry design prevents a model's acquisition output from entering later cells, but the supplied new fact is constructed from the canonical correct acquisition outcome. Without an exact checker-only label and provenance rule, this could be mistaken for acquisition-to-retention evidence.
ambiguities.question: Will every delayed-entry checkpoint be explicitly marked as model-independent supplied state, with acquisition, retention, and online-learning endpoints permanently inapplicable?

ambiguities.impact: The roster gives phase ceilings and the proposal requires 0|1|NA endpoints, but the complete endpoint-by-condition applicability table and every rejection rule for NA are not themselves enumerated as current durable source bytes.
ambiguities.question: Which exact endpoint matrix and reducer schema will bind NA, NOT_REACHED, ordinary behavioral zero, and whole-assay invalidity before model execution?

ambiguities.impact: The arithmetic is internally reproducible—501 maximum request slots and 148224 allowed generated tokens per root, 24072 slots and 7120896 tokens for DEV plus confirmation and sentinels—but physical hardware, local model files, renderer, tokenizer, and runtime hashes remain future authority inputs.
ambiguities.question: Which exact local model/runtime/device manifest and active-execution clock definition will be human-frozen before DEV, and how will any preflight reduction of ceilings be recorded without adding calls?

assumptions: The supplied V4 change and context hashes are the authoritative inputs; no implementation, preparation, model execution, or scientific run is authorized by this interpretation.
V4's 64 roots are an engineering census. The later 16 confirmation blocks are finite presentation blocks under one fixed topology and model, not independent population samples.

The public connected memory consists of explicit declarative atom/link projections and public event evidence. Semantic hashes, support roots, private root identities, scores, and oracle truth remain checker/controller state.

The fixed delayed-entry fixture is supplied public memory, not the output of a model acquisition. Consequently it cannot establish retention, acquisition-to-retention, online learning, or a persistent personal write.

A thinker attempt or outcome can seed a future DREAM cycle only after it becomes an eligible grounded ordinary public event, passes the applicable phase/join/chronology and independent-support boundary, and is admitted by a later separately ratified organism package.
M0's reference compiler is a deterministic conformance compiler, not DREAM. Its exhaustive pair proposals must not be credited as target-independent dream authorship.
LoRA is only future parametric personal state, written transactionally from validated semantics after separate gates. M0 and M-TEXT contain no LoRA parameters or persistent model update.

The exact bundled reader grants capabilities only through explicit returned grants; node aliases printed inside returned records do not become anchors, and the first relation attempt closes reading even when it produces NO_EFFECT.
Early terminal behavior seals unissued model-call suffixes as NOT_REACHED. There is no retry, root replacement, favorable selection, or reserve rescue.
The fixed delayed-entry interpretation is used for abbreviated cut and reachout conditions; those conditions do not borrow an AUTH model trajectory.
claim_delta_interpretation: The proposal narrows the immediate software claim to model-free conformance of a finite V4 instrument, including its visibility, provenance, intervention, durability, reducer, and handoff contracts. A later complete M-TEXT confirmation could support only a conditional statement that one frozen text model used supplied grounded atom-plus-authenticated-connection memory for substrate-neutral changed-goal and delayed-task behavior, with calibrated public evidence separately supporting informative experiment choice and revision. Connected-memory credit requires returned public capabilities plus cross-condition bridge and twin behavior; public uncertainty counts do not establish connected-memory causality. The fixed delayed-entry design deliberately removes the acquisition-to-retention link, so delayed success is supplied-memory integration after sterile reset, not the model retaining its own write. DREAM breadth-like local connection proposal, SLEEP validation and LoRA transport, persistent self-written memory, online feedback, parenting, accumulation, compression, lifetime improvement, baseline saturation, and complete-organism behavior remain untested and uncredited. Any invalid instrument, shortcut breach, failed noncompensatory gate, incomplete census, or resource halt withdraws the corresponding downstream claim rather than being compensated by another arm or reserve.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Separate authorization to author a candidate inert bundle from authorization to ratify or execute that bundle. Before any source-authoring permission is granted, bind an exact allowlist and source-manifest schema; before preparation execution, require the complete byte/hash manifest and a distinct human freeze.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The proposal asks the next human boundary to authorize creation of exact source bytes, while its ratifiability test says every source byte and hash must already be listed before preparation-source authorization. Treating those as the same gate would either violate the test or silently broaden authorization.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal's semantic direction is detailed, but its stated next source-authoring boundary is not operationally identical to the acceptance test's pre-authorization exact-byte boundary.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Name delayed-entry cells as supplied-memory factorial controls in every schema and claim, and prohibit any interpretation of their delayed endpoint as retention, acquisition-to-use, or online learning. Require the live AUTH acquisition-to-delayed path, if ever desired, as a separately registered condition.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The proposal correctly chooses model-independent delayed entry to preserve the 501-slot roster, but its plain-language description of combining newly admitted memory after reset can be read as an end-to-end thinker outcome even though the new fact is supplied by fixture construction.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal's delayed-entry design and its broad wording about later combining newly admitted memory are in tension unless the non-retention boundary is made mechanically prominent.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep uncertainty endpoints separate from connected-memory endpoints in schemas, reducers, and claim language; do not allow public calibration counts to contribute to connected-trace or DREAM-authorship credit.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The proposal states this distinction, but the same finite life narrative places public evidence, connected carrier use, acquisition, and delayed evaluation near one another. Without separate endpoint namespaces and applicability rules, later reporting could recombine them into a broader causal claim.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal's narrative sequence risks making public calibrated evidence appear to validate connected-memory causality, although the selected design only supports a separate prospective-evidence mechanism.

graph_delta_interpretation: The architecture adds a clean-room V4 source-contract node containing closed finite semantics, schemas, transition and failure rules, mutation fixtures, CAS rules, and the zero-V7 denylist. A deterministic preparation operation can read that bound source and one exact input binding, materialize the complete 64-root engineering universe without selection, and produce candidate content-addressed objects plus checker receipts. That candidate remains nonconsumable until an explicit second human fixture freeze. The frozen fixture then feeds a model-free M0 runtime and a public semantic handoff; checker-only authority, provenance, scores, and private mappings terminate at the checker/reducer boundary. A later separately approved M-TEXT package consumes only the verified public handoff projection and its own exact rendered/session contract. It may generate temporary policy traces and task outcomes but cannot mutate M0 fixtures, source, checker truth, or upstream authority. No edge connects this supplied-memory relay to DREAM authorship, SLEEP/LoRA transport, parenting, clean-lineage promotion, lifetime learning, or whole-organism credit. In the deferred organism, public grounded action-outcome episodes can later enter DREAM only after eligibility, chronological support, and independent later evidence; DREAM may propose broad target-independent local connections, while THINK constructs a goal-directed path through explicit memory only when a goal is released.

open_questions: Rohin Ghosh must explicitly ratify the exact V4 source direction and the precise scope of any inert preparation-source authoring; agreement or this interpretation cannot infer that authorization.

The human decision must preserve zero FeltCraft V7 runtime reuse, the two-freeze exception, the finite M0/M-TEXT claim ceiling, and the prohibition on implementation, materialization, model/tokenizer use, GPU work, and scientific claims at this stage.

The exact-source-ratifiability question must be resolved before treating the next source-authoring step as authorized: either distinguish candidate source creation from preparation authorization or provide the complete hash-bound source bundle first.

Any later source, fixture, runtime, renderer, tokenizer, endpoint, split, resource, or claim change requires a new deliberated and human-ratified scope; no stage auto-promotes to implementation, M-TEXT, or science.

loop_delta_interpretation: The authority loop is staged and non-automatic: a human may first authorize only exact inert source authoring; a separate human-approved deterministic preparation then reads the frozen source and input binding, writes content-addressed candidate objects and receipts, runs two disjoint checkers, and stops at one terminal candidate result. It has no RNG, search, root filtering, retry, replacement, model feedback, or favorable stopping. A second human freeze alone admits the candidate as a nonclaim fixture. M0 then runs finite episodes over a frozen root: it exposes public views, fixed non-oracular action opportunities, bundled memory returns, and ordinary events; it writes public evidence, provenance/checker receipts, and one root receipt. Relation actions consume one of four action opportunities. The first relation attempt, including NO_EFFECT, closes reading; malformed/private/instrument failures fail closed, while ordinary policy failures are charged behavioral outcomes. Lost-response replay is idempotent once, a third identical non-progressing command is blocked, and resets clear the specified volatile state. The M-TEXT roster has 18 conditions and uses maximum slot envelopes rather than guaranteed calls: two full 43-slot conditions, eight 39-slot conditions, two 26-slot conditions, one 4-slot uncertainty condition, three 13-slot delayed-entry conditions, and two 4-call tapes, totaling 501 slots and 148224 allowed generated tokens per root. The explicit split is DEV k={0,6,8,14,17,23,25,31}, confirmation k={1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15,16,18,20,22,24,26,28,30}, and reserve k={2,4,10,12,19,21,27,29}, with both h twins together. DEV and confirmation comprise 48 roots, 24 presentation blocks, 24048 model-call slots, plus 24 sentinels for 24072 maximum slots; early terminal cells seal their unused suffixes as NOT_REACHED. Confirmation uses exact twin-min finite census rates, no p-values or population uncertainty, no efficacy-based stopping, and no reserve rescue. In the deferred complete organism, an episode is observed as a grounded ordinary action/outcome transition; target-independent DREAM can propose many local compositional connections or re-expressions to grow breadth; independent later support can validate or revoke them; SLEEP can transactionally write only validated personal semantics into LoRA-parametric state; THINK can retrieve and compose explicit declarative memory under a goal, choose an action, observe its outcome, and revise temporary working state. A thinker attempt or outcome becomes eligible for a later dream only after the ordinary public event is formed and crosses the registered phase/join/chronological-support boundary. Private scratch, abandoned branch work, command and retrieval transcripts, correctness, scores, timing, condition labels, and checker truth are discarded or excluded. M0's reference compiler and M-TEXT's supplied carrier do not instantiate this deferred loop, and neither creates persistent personal memory or a whole-organism learning signal.
system_thesis_interpretation: The intended organism remains a recurrent Dream–LoRA–Think system, but V4 implements only a ruler for a narrow relay. In the full deferred architecture, lived action and ordinary outcome are first public grounded evidence. DREAM is target-independent and breadth-like: it proposes local connections or re-expressions across eligible facts without knowing the later goal, then waits for independent later evidence to support or revoke them. SLEEP is a separate consolidation boundary that transactionally transports validated personal semantics into LoRA-parametric state; it is neither an explicit graph node nor temporary scratch. THINK is goal-directed: it retrieves explicit declarative nodes and authenticated links, composes a path demanded by the current goal, acts, observes, and revises temporary plan/belief/scratch state. M0 contains explicit finite nodes, transition atoms, links, event records, carriers, and checker provenance; it has no learned child, LoRA, DREAM writer, or persistent self-written memory. M-TEXT uses supplied public carrier projections and temporary model state only. Its positive evidence can credit a fixed model's supplied-memory use, separate calibrated-evidence use, and, if all paired conditions pass, bounded connected-path behavior; it cannot credit discovery, consolidation, retention of the model's own acquisition, online learning, parenting, lifetime improvement, or the complete organism. Module-level receipts establish finite software invariants and, later, specific reader/carrier/intervention behavior. Whole-organism credit requires future packages connecting authored DREAM proposals, supported SLEEP transport, goal-conditioned THINK, and later action/outcome feedback under their own units and gates. Scale is intentionally finite: all 64 roots are checked for engineering conformance, while the 16 confirmation blocks summarize one fixed topology/model census. Resource and retry behavior are part of the instrument: fixed catalogs and budgets, eight pre-action reads, four relation attempts, 501 maximum model-call slots per root, no retries or replacements, explicit negative dispositions, and fail-closed durability. The semantic contrast between dreaming and thinking is therefore preserved conceptually but not experimentally instantiated by V4.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: Information moves directionally through six boundaries. Authorization may inspect exact source, private-world semantics, public evidence, carrier contracts, intervention rules, and future model-facing bindings, but authorization visibility does not grant actor access. Preparation and checkers may use private world truth, expected outcomes, support roots, manifests, and mutation oracles only to construct or validate frozen artifacts; none is public evidence. M0 internally reads frozen root/deck and controller state, then emits only canonical public events, finite views, neutral node/atom/link capabilities, ordinary outcomes, and the permitted semantic handoff. The actor/model sees released goals, fixed action catalogs, public state, public events, uncertainty counts where applicable, returned records, explicit budgets, repeat/reset status, and temporary scratch fields; it cannot see root bits, condition or arm labels, schedules, scores, expected answers, semantic/support hashes, private slot maps, checker receipts, filenames, timings, hidden branch work, or legality-derived action subsets. The fixed catalog is an opportunity surface rather than an oracle. The common reader depends only on carrier, public anchor, cursor, reader-open state, and repeat state; returned grants—not printed node aliases or immutable slot existence—create later capabilities. Public join state contains only the canonical goal and fixed probe slots; abandoned branch traces, workspace, dependencies, correctness, failures, timing, and sibling handles are destroyed. At delayed reset, matched carrier arms retain only the immutable old and condition-appropriate supplied new carrier; raw-context, RAG, and native-graph arms deliberately retain alternative external memory and are therefore excluded from the sole-channel interpretation. M-TEXT receives only the rendered public projection and permitted within-phase scratch under a separately frozen system/user/template/token/parser/session contract. Model outputs remain local temporary traces and receipts. Checker-only provenance, endpoint truth, split identity, and private routing do not reach model-visible bytes. In the future organism, only an eligible public grounded outcome crossing the registered chronological support boundary may be read by DREAM; private thought, abandoned branches, synthetic-only proposals, and ungrounded outcomes are discarded or remain ineligible.
